# Product Catalog Management Requirements

## Executive Summary

The product catalog management system serves as the foundation of our multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace, enabling multiple independent sellers to list, manage, and organize their products within a unified shopping experience. The system must support complex product variations, real-time inventory tracking, sophisticated categorization, and powerful search capabilities while maintaining consistency across all sellers.

THE product catalog SHALL support unlimited products across multiple sellers with hierarchical categorization, variant management, and real-time inventory updates.

## Product Listing Requirements

### Core Product Information

WHEN a seller creates a new product listing, THE system SHALL require the following mandatory fields:
- Product name (2-200 characters)
- Product description (minimum 50 characters, maximum 5,000 characters)
- Primary product category (must be leaf category)
- Base price (positive decimal with 2 decimal places)
- Currency (validated against supported currencies)
- Product condition (new, used, refurbished)
- SKU (seller-specific unique identifier, alphanumeric)
- Weight for shipping calculations (positive decimal)
- Dimensions (length, width, height in centimeters)

THE system SHALL support optional product fields including:
- Secondary categories (up to 3 additional categories)
- Brand name (validated against brand database)
- Manufacturer part number
- Product tags (up to 10 tags, 3-20 characters each)
- SEO meta title (max 60 characters)
- SEO meta description (max 160 characters)
- Product video URL (validated YouTube or Vimeo links)
- Product manual upload (PDF, max 10MB)
- Country of origin (ISO country code)
- Harmonized System (HS) code for international shipping

### Product Media Requirements

THE system SHALL handle product images with the following specifications:
- Minimum 1 image, maximum 10 images per product
- Primary image designation (required)
- Image formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
- Minimum resolution: 800x800 pixels
- Maximum file size: 5MB per image
- Automatic thumbnail generation (200x200, 400x400)
- Image alt text for accessibility (required for primary image)

WHEN a seller uploads product images, THE system SHALL validate image quality including resolution, format, and file size before acceptance.

### Multi-Seller Product Handling

THE system SHALL support multiple sellers offering the same product while maintaining separate listings:
- Each seller can create independent listings for identical products
- Product comparison features to show different seller offerings
- Price comparison across sellers for same products
- Seller rating integration in product display
- Independent inventory tracking per seller
- Separate shipping options per seller listing

WHERE multiple sellers offer the same product, THE system SHALL group listings for customer comparison while preserving seller independence.

## Category System

### Hierarchical Category Structure

THE system SHALL implement a hierarchical category system with the following structure:
- Root categories (top-level, e.g., Electronics, Clothing, Home & Garden)
- Subcategories (multiple levels supported, max depth 5)
- Leaf categories (final level where products are assigned)
- Category path navigation (breadcrumb display)

WHEN organizing categories, THE system SHALL enforce:
- Unique category names within same parent level
- Logical category hierarchy preventing circular references
- SEO-friendly category URLs
- Category descriptions for search optimization
- Category images for visual navigation

### Category Assignment Rules

THE system SHALL validate category assignments with business rules:
- Products must be assigned to leaf categories only
- Products can belong to multiple categories (maximum 4)
- Category changes require approval for established products
- Historical category tracking for analytics
- Automatic category suggestions based on product attributes

WHERE a seller assigns a product to a category, THE system SHALL validate the assignment against category rules and suggest optimal categorization.

### Category Management

THE system SHALL provide category management features including:
- Category creation with parent assignment
- Category editing with child inheritance rules
- Category merging capabilities
- Category deletion with product reassignment
- Category attribute templates for consistent product data
- Featured category designation for promotional displays

## Variant Management

### Variant Types and Options

THE system SHALL support product variants with the following capabilities:
- Multiple variant types per product (color, size, material, style)
- Up to 3 variant types per product
- Up to 50 variant combinations per product
- Variant-specific pricing (base price + variant premium)
- Variant-specific images (automatic gallery generation)
- Variant-specific SKUs and inventory

WHEN a product has variants, THE system SHALL require:
- Variant type names (e.g., "Color", "Size", "Material")
- Variant option values (e.g., "Red", "Blue", "Large", "Cotton")
- Unique SKU per variant combination
- Individual inventory tracking per variant
- Variant-specific pricing if different from base

### SKU Management

THE system SHALL implement comprehensive SKU management:
- Automatic SKU generation based on product and variant attributes
- Manual SKU override capability for sellers
- SKU uniqueness validation across seller's catalog
- SKU history tracking for discontinued variants
- Bulk SKU updates through import/export
- SKU pattern validation (alphanumeric, dashes, underscores)

THE system SHALL generate SKUs using the pattern: [SELLER-PREFIX]-[PRODUCT-ID]-[VARIANT-CODES]

### Variant Inventory Tracking

THE system SHALL track inventory at the variant level with:
- Real-time inventory updates per SKU
- Low stock alerts (configurable threshold)
- Out-of-stock variant handling (hide or show unavailable)
- Backorder capability per variant
- Inventory reservation during checkout process
- Inventory sync across multiple warehouse locations

WHEN inventory reaches zero for a variant, THE system SHALL automatically mark that variant as unavailable while keeping other variants active.

## Search and Discovery

### Search Functionality

THE system SHALL provide advanced search capabilities including:
- Full-text search across product names, descriptions, and attributes
- Search result relevance ranking based on multiple factors
- Search query suggestions and autocomplete
- Search result filtering and faceted navigation
- Search history for logged-in users
- Search analytics and performance tracking

THE search algorithm SHALL consider:
- Exact phrase matches (highest relevance)
- Individual keyword matches
- Category relevance
- Product popularity and sales velocity
- Seller reputation and ratings
- Product availability status
- Search term location (title vs description)

### Filtering and Faceted Navigation

THE system SHALL support comprehensive filtering options:
- Price range filtering with custom range input
- Category-based filtering with multi-select
- Attribute-based filtering (brand, material, features)
- Variant option filtering (color, size)
- Seller-based filtering
- Shipping options filtering (free shipping, expedited)
- Product condition filtering (new, used, refurbished)
- Rating-based filtering (minimum star rating)

WHEN displaying search results, THE system SHALL provide faceted navigation showing available filter options with result counts.

### Product Sorting Options

THE system SHALL offer multiple sorting mechanisms:
- Relevance (default for search queries)
- Price (low to high, high to low)
- Popularity (sales velocity)
- Newest first
- Customer rating (highest rated)
- Best selling
- Discount percentage (for sale items)

## Catalog Organization

### Product Collections

THE system SHALL support curated product collections:
- Manual collection creation by sellers
- Automated collections based on rules (price, category, tags)
- Featured collection highlighting
- Seasonal and promotional collections
- Cross-sell and upsell collections
- Customer-specific personalized collections

THE system SHALL enable collection management including:
- Collection naming and description
- Collection image and banner upload
- Product assignment (manual or rule-based)
- Collection sorting and display order
- Collection visibility settings
- Collection performance analytics

### Product Relationships

THE system SHALL establish product relationships for enhanced discovery:
- Related products (manual assignment or algorithm-based)
- Frequently bought together recommendations
- Cross-category suggestions
- Alternative product suggestions
- Accessory and complementary product links
- Bundle and kit creation capabilities

### Catalog Browsing Experience

THE system SHALL optimize catalog browsing with:
- Category-based navigation with subcategory drill-down
- Brand-based browsing with alphabetical filters
- New arrivals sections with time-based filtering
- Sale and promotion sections
- Trending products identification
- Recently viewed products tracking

WHEN a customer browses the catalog, THE system SHALL maintain browsing history and provide easy navigation back to previously viewed sections.

## Product Visibility Rules

### Product Status Management

THE system SHALL manage product visibility through status controls:
- Draft (not visible to customers)
- Active (visible and available for purchase)
- Inactive (visible but not purchasable)
- Discontinued (hidden from new customers)
- Under Review (pending approval)
- Rejected (not published, feedback provided)

THE system SHALL automatically change product status based on:
- Inventory levels reaching zero
- Seller account suspension
- Product violation reports
- System policy violations
- Category requirement compliance

### Approval Workflow

WHERE product approval is required, THE system SHALL implement:
- New product submission review process
- Automated content filtering for policy violations
- Manual review queue for flagged products
- Approval notification to sellers
- Rejection reasons and resubmission guidance
- Expedited approval for trusted sellers

### Geographic and Market Restrictions

THE system SHALL support product visibility restrictions:
- Geographic availability (country/region restrictions)
- Market-specific product compliance
- Shipping destination limitations
- Currency and pricing market adaptation
- Local regulation compliance checking
- Tax and duty calculation requirements

WHEN displaying products to customers, THE system SHALL filter results based on customer's location and applicable market restrictions.

## Business Rules and Constraints

### Product Data Validation

THE system SHALL enforce product data validation rules:
- Prohibited content filtering (offensive, illegal, restricted items)
- Category-specific required attributes
- Price validation (minimum $0.01, maximum $999,999.99)
- Image quality and content standards
- Description minimum length requirements
- SKU format validation per seller preferences

IF a seller attempts to list prohibited items, THEN THE system SHALL reject the listing and provide clear explanation of policy violations.

### Competitive Pricing Rules

THE system SHALL monitor and manage competitive pricing:
- Price comparison across sellers for identical products
- Automatic price matching notifications
- Minimum advertised price (MAP) compliance
- Price history tracking and analytics
- Competitive pricing alerts for sellers
- Dynamic pricing recommendations

### Quality Assurance

THE system SHALL maintain catalog quality through:
- Duplicate product detection and merging
- Image quality standards enforcement
- Description plagiarism detection
- Category miscalculation identification
- Incomplete product information flagging
- Regular catalog audit and cleanup processes

## Performance Requirements

### Search Performance

THE search functionality SHALL meet performance requirements:
- Search results return within 2 seconds
- Autocomplete suggestions appear within 200ms
- Filter application updates results within 1 second
- Search indexing updates within 5 minutes
- Support for 10,000+ concurrent searches
- 99.9% search availability

### Catalog Scalability

THE system SHALL support catalog growth requirements:
- Unlimited product listings per seller
- Support for 1+ million total products
- 10,000+ categories and subcategories
- 100+ simultaneous seller catalog updates
- Real-time inventory synchronization
- Efficient bulk operations for large catalogs

WHEN handling peak traffic periods, THE system SHALL maintain catalog performance and prevent slowdowns in product browsing and search functionality.

## Error Handling and User Experience

### Product Listing Errors

THE system SHALL provide clear error messages for common product listing issues:
- Missing required field identification
- Image upload failure explanations
- Category assignment validation errors
- Inventory quantity validation
- Price formatting corrections
- Duplicate SKU detection and resolution

### Customer-Facing Error Scenarios

IF product information is unavailable due to system errors, THEN THE system SHALL:
- Display cached product information when available
- Show alternative product suggestions
- Provide customer service contact options
- Log errors for administrative review
- Maintain shopping cart integrity
- Gracefully degrade catalog features

This comprehensive approach ensures a robust, scalable, and user-friendly product catalog that serves both sellers and customers effectively while maintaining data integrity and system performance across the multi-vendor marketplace platform.

# Order Processing Workflow - Requirements Analysis Report

## Executive Summary

This document defines the complete order processing workflow for the shopping-mall multi-vendor e-commerce platform. The system must handle complex scenarios including multi-seller orders, real-time inventory management, order splitting logic, and comprehensive refund processing while maintaining a seamless customer experience.

## 1. Shopping Cart Management

### Cart Operations
THE shopping cart system SHALL allow customers to add products to their cart from multiple sellers simultaneously. WHEN a customer adds a product, THE system SHALL verify inventory availability in real-time and update the cart total immediately. IF inventory becomes unavailable after adding to cart, THEN THE system SHALL notify the customer and remove or mark the item as unavailable.

### Cart Persistence
THE cart SHALL persist across customer sessions for guest users for 30 days using browser local storage, and for authenticated users indefinitely until cleared or checked out. WHEN a customer returns to the platform, THE system SHALL restore their previous cart contents automatically.

### Cart Modifications
WHILE items are in the cart, THE customer SHALL be able to update quantities, remove items, or save items to wishlist. WHEN quantity is updated, THE system SHALL re-verify inventory availability and recalculate totals including applicable shipping costs and taxes.

### Multi-Seller Cart Display
THE cart interface SHALL clearly group items by seller with separate subtotals for each seller's products. WHEN displaying cart contents, THE system SHALL show estimated shipping costs per seller based on customer's default address or selected delivery location.

## 2. Checkout Process

### Guest Checkout
WHEN a guest customer initiates checkout, THE system SHALL prompt for email address and create a temporary account to track the order. THE guest SHALL have the option to create a permanent account after checkout completion with all order history transferred to the new account.

### Authentication Check
WHEN checkout begins, THE system SHALL verify customer authentication status. IF the customer is not authenticated, THEN THE system SHALL offer account login, account creation, or guest checkout options without losing cart contents.

### Address Management
THE checkout process SHALL allow customers to select from saved addresses or add new delivery addresses. WHEN a new address is entered, THE system SHALL validate the address format and provide real-time shipping cost calculations from all sellers in the order.

### Shipping Method Selection
THE system SHALL present shipping options per seller based on delivery address, with estimated delivery dates and costs. WHEN customer selects different shipping methods for different sellers, THE system SHALL calculate and display separate delivery timelines.

## 3. Order Creation

### Order Validation
WHEN a customer confirms checkout, THE system SHALL perform comprehensive validation including inventory verification, payment method validation, and seller availability checks. IF any validation fails, THEN THE system SHALL return the customer to checkout with clear error messages.

### Order Number Generation
THE system SHALL generate unique order numbers using format ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX where XXXXXX represents a sequential number. THE order number SHALL be displayed immediately upon successful order creation and used as the primary reference throughout the fulfillment process.

### Multi-Seller Order Splitting
WHEN an order contains products from multiple sellers, THE system SHALL automatically create separate sub-orders for each seller while maintaining the parent order relationship. THE customer SHALL receive one master order number with individual seller order references for tracking purposes.

### Inventory Reservation
THE system SHALL reserve inventory for all order items immediately upon order creation. THE inventory reservation SHALL be held for 2 hours pending payment completion, after which unclaimed reservations are automatically released.

## 4. Payment Processing

### Payment Gateway Integration
THE system SHALL support multiple payment methods including credit/debit cards, digital wallets, bank transfers, and platform-specific payment options. WHEN processing payments, THE system SHALL use PCI-compliant payment gateways with tokenization to ensure security.

### Split Payment Handling
FOR multi-seller orders, THE system SHALL calculate seller-specific amounts including product costs, shipping fees, and applicable taxes per seller. THE customer SHALL make a single payment that is automatically distributed to individual seller accounts upon successful payment confirmation.

### Payment Authorization
WHEN payment is submitted, THE system SHALL authorize the full order amount and capture funds only after all sellers confirm product availability. IF any seller cannot fulfill their portion of the order, THEN THE system SHALL adjust the payment amount accordingly.

### Payment Failure Recovery
IF payment processing fails, THEN THE system SHALL attempt alternative payment methods if available, return customer to payment selection, or temporarily hold the order while notifying customer to retry payment. THE inventory reservation SHALL be extended by 30 minutes during payment retry attempts.

## 5. Order Splitting for Sellers

### Sub-Order Creation
THE system SHALL automatically split master orders into individual seller sub-orders containing only that seller's products. EACH sub-order SHALL inherit the master order number with a seller-specific suffix (e.g., ORD-20241115-000001-A, ORD-20241115-000001-B).

### Seller Notification
WHEN sub-orders are created, THE system SHALL immediately notify each seller via email and in-app notification with order details, customer shipping address, and delivery requirements. THE notification SHALL include links to seller dashboard for order processing.

### Independent Fulfillment
EACH seller SHALL process their sub-order independently with separate packaging, shipping, and tracking. THE system SHALL track each sub-order's progress separately while maintaining visibility of the overall customer order status.

### Cross-Seller Coordination
WHILE sellers operate independently, THE system SHALL coordinate delivery timing to minimize multiple deliveries to the same customer address on the same day when possible. THE platform SHALL suggest optimal shipping schedules based on customer preferences and seller locations.

## 6. Fulfillment Workflow

### Order Confirmation Process
WHEN sellers receive sub-order notifications, THEY SHALL confirm product availability and estimated processing time within 2 business hours. IF a seller cannot fulfill their portion of the order, THEN THE system SHALL notify the customer with options to cancel the affected items or substitute with alternative sellers.

### Packaging Requirements
SELLERS SHALL package products according to platform standards including appropriate protective materials, branded packaging if applicable, and including return instructions. THE system SHALL provide packaging guidelines specific to product categories and shipping methods selected.

### Shipping Label Generation
THE system SHALL generate shipping labels with tracking numbers when sellers confirm order processing. THE labels SHALL include customer address, return address, order reference numbers, and delivery instructions in the appropriate language for the destination.

### Quality Control Checkpoints
BEFORE shipping, SELLERS SHALL perform quality control checks including product condition verification, correct item dispatch, and packaging integrity. THE system SHALL provide quality control checklists specific to product categories and value levels.

## 7. Delivery Tracking

### Real-Time Tracking Integration
THE system SHALL integrate with shipping carrier APIs to provide real-time tracking updates for all sub-orders. CUSTOMERS SHALL access tracking information through their order dashboard with estimated delivery windows and current package locations.

### Multi-Package Tracking
FOR orders with multiple sellers, THE system SHALL aggregate tracking information from all carriers into a unified tracking view. THE customer SHALL see the status of each package with expected delivery dates for all components of their order.

### Delivery Notifications
THE system SHALL send proactive notifications to customers at key delivery milestones including package dispatch, in-transit updates, out-for-delivery status, and successful delivery confirmation. THE notifications SHALL be sent via customer's preferred communication channels.

### Delivery Exception Handling
WHEN delivery exceptions occur (failed delivery, address issues, damaged packages), THE system SHALL immediately notify both customer and relevant seller with specific exception details and available resolution options. THE platform SHALL coordinate between sellers and shipping carriers to resolve exceptions efficiently.

## 8. Returns & Refunds

### Return Policy Framework
THE system SHALL support seller-specific return policies with platform minimum standards including 14-day return window for most products and 7-day return window for perishable or personalized items. THE return policy SHALL be clearly displayed during checkout for each product.

### Return Request Process
WHEN customers request returns, THE system SHALL guide them through the return process including reason selection, product condition documentation, and return shipping label generation. THE system SHALL verify return eligibility based on seller policies, product category, and time since delivery.

### Return Shipping Management
DEPENDING on return reasons and seller policies, THE system SHALL determine whether return shipping costs are borne by customer or seller. WHEN sellers are responsible for return costs, THE system SHALL generate prepaid return labels automatically.

### Refund Processing
UPON successful return delivery and seller verification, THE system SHALL process refunds within 3-5 business days based on original payment method. FOR multi-seller orders, REFUNDS SHALL be processed independently per seller with appropriate adjustments to seller balances.

### Partial Order Returns
WHEN customers return only selected items from multi-seller orders, THE system SHALL calculate refunds based on individual item costs, applicable taxes, and proportional shipping fees. THE remaining order components SHALL remain unaffected by partial returns.

## 9. Error Handling and Edge Cases

### Inventory Discrepancies
IF inventory discrepancies are discovered after order placement, THE system SHALL notify affected customers immediately with alternative options including product substitution, seller alternatives, or order cancellation with full refund.

### Payment Processing Delays
IF payment authorization succeeds but settlement is delayed, THE system SHALL hold orders in pending status while maintaining inventory reservations. THE platform SHALL retry failed settlement attempts and notify customers of any payment issues requiring action.

### Seller Performance Issues
WHEN sellers consistently fail to meet fulfillment standards, THE system SHALL implement progressive sanctions including order throttling, account review, and ultimately account suspension while ensuring minimal customer impact.

### System Integration Failures
IF external system integrations fail (payment gateways, shipping carriers, inventory systems), THE system SHALL maintain order data integrity and provide manual processing workflows to ensure business continuity.

## 10. Compliance and Security Requirements

### Data Protection
ALL order processing SHALL comply with applicable data protection regulations including PCI DSS for payment data and GDPR for customer information. THE system SHALL encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest with appropriate access controls.

### Audit Trail Requirements
THE system SHALL maintain complete audit trails for all order modifications including status changes, payment transactions, and inventory adjustments. THE audit trail SHALL be immutable and accessible for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

### Financial Reporting
THE platform SHALL provide comprehensive financial reporting for sellers including order volumes, revenue tracking, commission calculations, and tax reporting. THE reporting SHALL support multiple currencies and local tax requirements.

## Success Metrics and Performance Requirements

The order processing system SHALL maintain the following performance standards:
- Order creation response time: less than 2 seconds
- Payment processing completion: less than 5 seconds
- Inventory verification: real-time with inventory locks
- Notification delivery: within 30 seconds of status changes
- Tracking update frequency: every 6 hours minimum
- Return processing completion: within 24 hours of receipt

## User Experience Requirements

THE order processing workflow SHALL be designed for maximum customer convenience with clear progress indicators, transparent communication, and multiple support channels. THE system SHALL minimize required customer actions while ensuring comprehensive order management capabilities for all user types across the multi-vendor marketplace platform.

---

*This document defines the complete business requirements for order processing in the shopping-mall multi-vendor e-commerce platform. Technical implementation details including API specifications, database design, and system architecture are at the discretion of the development team.*

# Customer Experience Requirements

## Executive Summary

This document defines the comprehensive customer experience for the shopping-mall multi-vendor e-commerce platform, focusing on creating a seamless, engaging, and personalized shopping journey. The requirements encompass all customer touchpoints from initial product discovery through post-purchase support, ensuring satisfaction and building long-term customer relationships across multiple sellers in the marketplace ecosystem.

## Customer Journey Mapping

### Pre-Purchase Experience Excellence

THE shopping-mall platform SHALL provide a frictionless browsing experience optimized for all user types including registered customers, guest users, and mobile app users. WHEN a guest visits the platform, THE system SHALL allow complete product browsing capabilities including category navigation, product search functionality, and detailed product views with seller comparisons. THE guest experience SHALL include full cart management, product wishlist creation, and comprehensive product information display including multiple images, variant details, seller information, and real-time shipping estimates.

WHILE browsing as a registered customer, THE system SHALL provide sophisticated personalization through machine learning algorithms that analyze browsing history, purchase patterns, and behavioral indicators. THESE recommendations SHALL appear dynamically across the homepage, category pages, and product detail pages, updating continuously based on real-time user behavior. THE recommendation engine SHALL consider factors including recently viewed products from any seller, frequently purchased together items across the marketplace, trending products within relevant categories, historical price sensitivity patterns, and seasonal shopping behaviors specific to the customer's geographic location.

THE product discovery experience SHALL leverage multiple intelligent pathways to help customers find desired items efficiently including visual search capabilities where customers upload images to find similar products, voice search functionality optimized for mobile devices, predictive search with autocomplete that suggests products and categories as customers type, and personalized category recommendations based on previous shopping behavior. WHEN customers search for products, THE system SHALL return comprehensive results including products from all marketplace sellers carrying matching items with integrated comparison features.

### Account Registration and Profile Management

THE account creation process SHALL require minimal information while ensuring security including email address validation, secure password setup with complexity requirements, and optional social media account integration supporting Google, Facebook, and Apple ID authentication. THE system SHALL implement progressive profiling where additional information is collected over time in exchange for personalized benefits rather than requiring everything upfront.

WHERE customers provide profile information, THE system SHALL use this data to immediately personalize their experience including preferred language localization based on geographic location, currency display for international customers, communication channel preferences for marketing and transactional messages, and delivery preferences including alternative delivery addresses and delivery timing preferences. THE profile management SHALL support multiple shipping addresses with intelligent default selection based on product categories and delivery zones.

THE customer account dashboard SHALL provide comprehensive account management including order history across all marketplace sellers with unified tracking, wishlist management with sharing capabilities, saved shopping cart items that persist across sessions, payment method management with secure storage and multiple options, communication preferences for different notification types, and privacy controls enabling customers to manage data sharing and marketing preferences.

## Review and Rating System

### Verified Purchase Review Framework

THE review system SHALL ensure authenticity by requiring purchase verification before allowing product reviews. THE system SHALL automatically verify purchases by cross-referencing customer order histories with product SKUs, eliminating manual verification delays while maintaining comprehensive fraud prevention. THE verification process SHALL exclude returns, cancelled orders, and refunds from review eligibility while maintaining transparency about verification criteria.

WHERE customers attempt to submit reviews without verified purchases, THE system SHALL provide clear explanations of verification requirements and suggest that they contact customer service if they believe this determination is incorrect. THE verification SHALL consider bundle purchases, gift purchases, and partial returns ensuring fair access to review functionality while maintaining system integrity against artificial review manipulation.

### Comprehensive Review Collection Process

THE review submission interface SHALL be accessible through multiple touchpoints including order confirmation emails sent 7 days after delivery, customer account dashboard with prominent "Rate Your Purchase" sections, and direct links within shipping confirmation emails with clear "Leave a Review" calls-to-action. THE review system SHALL support multiple media types including text reviews with 50-5000 character limits per customer segmentation, photo uploads showing actual product conditions with automatic moderation, and video reviews up to 3 minutes in length with quality guidelines.

THE review collection SHALL use intelligent timing algorithms that optimize for completion rates while ensuring genuine product experience including automatic review requests sent 7-10 days after delivery confirmation for standard products, immediate review requests for digital products upon delivery, extended review windows for seasonal products reflecting actual usage periods, and targeted follow-up communications for customers who have not reviewed products despite verified purchases.

### Review Moderation and Quality Assurance

THE review moderation system SHALL balance automation efficiency with human oversight to maintain quality and authenticity. THE automated filtering SHALL detect and flag reviews containing inappropriate language, competitor mentions, personal information exposure, external website links, advertising content, or off-topic discussions for human review within 4 business hours. THE machine learning algorithms SHALL continuously improve the detection of fake reviews through pattern analysis of reviewer behavior and linguistic characteristics.

THE review approval process SHALL maintain consistent publication timing with reviews appearing on product pages within 5 minutes of submission while ensuring appropriate content screening. THE system SHALL provide review voting mechanisms where customers can vote on review helpfulness, which influences review ranking and visibility. THE moderation system SHALL maintain reviewer anonymity while providing sellers access to reviewer history patterns for quality assessment purposes.

### Rating Aggregation and Analytics

THE rating calculation system SHALL use weighted statistical methods reflecting current product experiences while respecting historical feedback. THE overall product rating SHALL display as both numerical scores and visual star representations, updating in real-time as new reviews are processed. THE weighted algorithm SHALL consider review recency, review helpfulness votes, reviewer verification history, and comparative analysis against category averages to generate balanced product rankings.

THE seller performance analytics through the dashboard shall include comprehensive rating breakdowns showing performance trends over customizable periods, comparative analysis against marketplace average for relevant categories, specific customer feedback categorization including product quality, shipping reliability, and customer service experiences, and recognition programs highlighting top-rated sellers with increased visibility and promotional opportunities.

## Customer Support Requirements

### Multi-Channel Support Infrastructure

THE customer support system shall provide comprehensive assistance through multiple accessible channels designed to resolve customer issues efficiently and support marketplace operations excellence. THE live chat support shall operate during extended business hours covering peak shopping periods across different time zones, with specialized agents trained to handle complex multi-seller order issues including split shipments, partial returns, and seller coordination requirements.

THE email support shall guarantee response within 24 hours for routine inquiries and 4 hours for urgent matters including delivery issues affecting promised timeframes or technical problems impacting order completion. THE ticket management system shall automatically categorize and route inquiries based on keywords and customer history analysis, ensuring specialized agents handle complex issues while efficient routing maintains service level agreements.

THE phone support shall be available for premium customers achieving specified account tiers through purchase history or subscription services, and for complex situations requiring personal attention including payment disputes, account security concerns, or high-value order complications. THE integrated phone support shall provide agents with complete customer account access including order histories across all marketplace sellers, enabling informed assistance without requiring customers to repeat information or transaction details.

### Self-Service Help Portal and Knowledge Management

THE self-service help portal shall address 80% of common customer inquiries through comprehensive, searchable knowledge resources including step-by-step guides with illustrations and video demonstrations, policy explanation sections clarifying marketplace policies for customers, sellers, and platform operations, technical troubleshooting guides covering common issues including account access, payment problems, and shipping delays.

THE interactive help features shall streamline customer issue resolution through an order tracking assistant that automatically detects order-related queries in support tickets and provides real-time shipping updates, invoice and receipt generation tools allowing customers to download transaction documentation, return initiation wizards that guide customers through return processes including label generation and refund estimates based on platform policies and seller-specific return windows.

THE knowledge base content shall be continuously updated based on customer feedback analysis, emerging issue identification through support ticket categorization, and user experience testing to optimize self-service success rates. THE system shall track knowledge article usage, identify content gaps through failed search queries, and prioritize content improvements based on potential impact on customer satisfaction scores.

### Escalation Management and Quality Assurance

THE escalation process shall implement clear pathways ensuring customer issues receive appropriate attention based on complexity, severity, and business impact. THE Level 1 support shall handle general inquiries, basic account assistance, and standard processes including password resets, address changes, and order status updates using established knowledge base procedures.

THE Level 2 escalation shall address complex multi-seller order issues including payment disputes, seller performance concerns, return negotiations between multiple parties, and technical problems requiring deeper investigation across system logs and transaction histories. THE Level 2 agents shall have enhanced system access including refund processing capabilities, seller communication channels, and policy interpretation authority.

THE Level 3 escalation shall occur for situations requiring management approval, legal consultation, or resolution of platform-wide issues affecting multiple customers simultaneously. THESE cases shall include payment gateway failures, coordinated seller violations, account security breaches, or regulatory compliance matters requiring specialized handling procedures and documentation.

## Wishlist Management System

### Account-Based Wishlist Architecture

THE wishlist functionality shall operate exclusively for registered and authenticated customers, providing persistent cross-device functionality while encouraging account creation through limited "Save for Later" features for guest users. THE system shall maintain unlimited wishlist capacity with intelligent organization supporting automatic categorization by product type, custom category creation reflecting personal preferences, priority tagging systems enabling urgency or interest level indication, and collaborative features allowing customers to share selected wishlists with friends or family members for gift coordination.

THE wishlist cross-seller management shall seamlessly handle products from multiple marketplace sellers while maintaining usability despite potential complexity. WHEN customers add items from different sellers to a single wishlist, THE system shall preserve seller-specific information including pricing, shipping costs, availability status, and promotional information while providing unified layout and browsing experiences. THE availability monitoring shall continuously watch wishlist items across all sellers, alerting customers when items return to stock, become available from alternative sellers, or when prices decrease below specified thresholds.

### Price and Availability Intelligence

THE price tracking functionality shall monitor wishlist items continuously across all marketplace sellers providing intelligent notification systems for price-sensitive customers. THE price drop alerts shall notify customers when items decrease by specified percentages or predetermined amounts, with customizable notification frequencies and price thresholds based on item categories or individual product preferences. THE stock level monitoring shall provide availability alerts when wishlist items become available from sellers that may offer better terms including improved shipping costs, faster delivery options, or favorable return policies.

THE wishlist analytics shall provide customers with comprehensive insights including price history graphs showing trending patterns and optimal purchase timing recommendations, availability probability estimates based on seller performance data and seasonal patterns, and recommendation engines suggesting similar products or complementary items based on wishlist contents and purchase history correlations across the marketplace ecosystem.

### Integrated Shopping Experience

THE wishlist-to-purchase workflow shall provide comprehensive purchasing options while maintaining shopping flexibility and supporting customer decision optimization. THE bulk purchase functionality shall enable customers to add multiple wishlist items to cart simultaneously with automatic grouping by seller to optimize checkout experiences and minimize shipping complications. THE save-for-later integration shall allow seamless transfer of saved items from shopping cart to wishlist for future consideration without losing product variant selections, quantity preferences, or seller specifications.

THE gift registry functionality shall extend wishlist capabilities for special occasions including weddings, birthdays, or holidays with date-specific tracking, wishlist sharing options through email or social media, and guest privacy settings allowing public or private visibility controls. THE collaborative shopping features shall enable friends or family members to suggest additions, comment on selections, or coordinate group purchases directly through platform communications while maintaining gift recipient surprise elements when necessary.

## Notification System Architecture

### Personalized Communication Channels

THE notification system shall adapt intelligently to customer preferences while maintaining essential communications about account status, order management, and security events. THE email communications shall serve as the primary channel for important updates including order confirmations, shipping notifications, account security alerts, and regulatory policy changes or updates. THE notification management shall provide granular control enabling opt-out of promotional emails while maintaining critical account and order communications through other preferred channels.

THE mobile push notification systems shall be available for customers installing and authorizing platform applications with restrictions ensuring only immediately relevant updates including order status changes, delivery tracking notifications, and time-sensitive offers on customer wishlist items below preferred price thresholds. THE SMS notifications shall be optional and customer-controlled without service fees to customers, primarily used for delivery coordination requiring real-time communication through final delivery phases while maintaining customer privacy through automatic number masking.

### Intelligent Content Targeting

THE notification system shall leverage customer data analysis and shopping behavior patterns to provide genuinely useful communications rather than intrusive marketing messages. THE wishlist notifications shall inform customers of price drops, restocking events, or limited-time offers on saved items within customer-specified price and interest thresholds while preventing notification spam through intelligent grouping and scheduling algorithms. THE abandoned cart reminders shall gently encourage checkout completion through helpful reminders including estimated shipping timeframes, inventory availability warnings, and relevant seller communications about item availability.

THE personalized recommendation notifications shall consider customer purchase history across sellers, browsing patterns through multiple sessions, and stated preferences to suggest relevant products from multiple marketplace sellers or complementary accessories and services. THE category trend notifications shall alert interested customers to new marketplace sellers, trending products in preferred categories, and seasonal items aligned with demonstrated shopping interests through historical order and wishlist activity across the platform ecosystem.

### Advanced Notification Management

THE notification preferences shall provide customers granular control over communication types and delivery frequency through comprehensive settings enabling precise communication channel management by message category. THE frequency management shall include daily, weekly, or monthly digest formats for non-urgent communications, reducing notification fatigue while maintaining customer awareness of platform updates and personal account changes. THE time zone awareness shall schedule bulk communications during appropriate local hours while considering customer-specified communication preferences for promotional versus account-related messages.

THE notification system shall implement intelligent delivery timing algorithms considering customer time zones, historical communication engagement patterns, and optimal open rates for different message types based on customer segmentation analysis. THE cross-platform synchronization shall ensure consistent notification states across mobile applications, web interfaces, and email communications avoiding duplicate messages while maintaining message acknowledgment tracking across all communication channels.

## Personalization and Customer Intelligence

### Cognitive Shopping Experience System

THE platform shall provide increasingly personalized experiences by learning from customer behavior patterns and explicitly stated preferences through profile management and feature usage analysis. THE browsing personalization shall adapt product discovery based on viewed items, search terms used across sessions, sellers followed through bookmark systems, categories frequently browsed, and seasonal timing patterns for gift-giving or personal shopping behaviors.

THE recommendation engine shall develop sophisticated cross-category intelligence where fashion customers receive tailored accessory suggestions, electronics customers see relevant component or accessory recommendations, and home improvement browsers receive complementary tools or material suggestions from different marketplace sellers based on predictive purchase patterns. THE behavioral analysis shall combine historical data with real-time browsing signals to maintain current relevance while respecting privacy preferences and usage limitations.

### Dynamic Interface Personalization

THE platform interface shall adapt intelligently to individual customer preferences while maintaining usability standards and accessibility requirements including screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation support. THE layout preferences shall allow customers to choose between visual layouts optimized for different device types, control product displays per page based on browsing speed and device capabilities, select preferred sorting methods for search results and category browsing, and access alternative navigation methods for improved accessibility when required.

THE content personalization shall modify homepage displays, featured product sections, and promotional areas based on customer profiles while maintaining discovery opportunities for new marketplace sellers and product categories outside established preferences. THE new seller discovery shall balance algorithmic preferences with random or trend-based introductions ensuring customers explore marketplace diversity while maintaining relevance to established shopping patterns and demonstrated interests across product categories and seller types.

### Advanced Analytics and Insights

THE customer intelligence system shall accumulate insights over time while maintaining strict privacy standards and providing customer controls for data usage and retention preferences. THE activity tracking shall focus on recent behaviors that inform immediate personalization without creating permanent behavioral profiles allowing customers to explore new interests without impacting established preferences through temporary browsing or research activities. THE purchase history analysis shall identify patterns enabling predictive features including subscription renewal reminders for consumable products from recurring sellers, seasonal timing recognition for holiday or gift purchase patterns, and replacement cycle awareness for durable goods requiring eventual replacement or upgrade.

THE demographic intelligence shall refine personalization accuracy when voluntarily provided through profile completion, survey participation, or stated preferences while maintaining strict data protection controls and opt-out capabilities for privacy-conscious customers. THE data retention policies shall automatically purge behavioral tracking data according to established schedules while preserving essential account information and purchase histories necessary for customer service and account management functions.

## Service Recovery and Customer Satisfaction

### Proactive Issue Identification and Response

THE service recovery system shall continuously monitor platform operations to identify potential service issues before they significantly impact customer satisfaction including delivery monitoring across all marketplace sellers and shipping carriers, payment processing success rates and authorization failures across payment methods, system performance metrics and response time degradation, seller performance indicators including customer satisfaction scores and policy compliance rates, and customer support ticket trends indicating emerging issues.

THE proactive customer communication shall alert affected customers immediately when service issues are detected that may impact their orders or account access including delayed deliveries beyond advertised timeframes with updated estimates and compensation options, payment processing failures with alternative method suggestions and retry opportunities, inventory discrepancies where ordered products become unavailable with substitution or cancellation alternatives, seller performance issues requiring intervention or policy enforcement, and platform-wide technical problems requiring customer action or affecting transaction processing.

### Swift Resolution and Customer Recovery

THE customer recovery process shall focus on satisfaction restoration over operational convenience through immediate acknowledgment channels, personal communication options for complex situations, comprehensive documentation and progress tracking systems, and flexible resolution options tailored to individual customer preferences and situation severity. THE resolution options shall include immediate account credits for service failures, expedited processing or shipping upgrades at platform expense, complimentary services or products as appropriate compensation for frustration or inconvenience, flexible return options and full refund processing where standard policies may not apply, and priority customer service access with senior agent assignment.

THE follow-up communication shall ensure customer satisfaction with problem resolution quality and offer additional assistance when needed while gathering feedback to inform platform improvement initiatives through satisfaction surveys, trend analysis of service recovery cases, identification of systemic issues requiring policy changes, and development of preventive measures based on root cause analysis. THE customer relationship building through effective service recovery shall transform problem situations into opportunities to demonstrate exceptional commitment to customer satisfaction and platform reliability that exceeds customer expectations and industry standards.

# Seller Management Requirements for Multi-Vendor E-commerce Platform

## Executive Summary

This document defines the comprehensive seller management system for our multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace platform. The system enables independent sellers to register, manage their product catalogs, process orders, access performance analytics, and receive payments through an automated commission-based revenue model. Our platform differentiates itself through streamlined seller onboarding, robust quality control mechanisms, and data-driven seller success tools that maximize both seller profitability and customer satisfaction.

## Seller Registration Process

### Initial Application Requirements

THE seller registration system SHALL collect comprehensive business information during the initial application phase. WHEN a prospective seller initiates registration, THE system SHALL require business name, legal entity type, tax identification number, business address, contact information, primary product categories, estimated monthly sales volume, and business registration documentation. WHERE the seller represents an international business, THE system SHALL provide localized registration forms and accept international tax identification numbers per regional requirements.

WHILE processing seller applications, THE system SHALL perform multi-layered verification including business entity validation, tax ID verification, address confirmation through postal service APIs, phone number verification via SMS authentication, email address confirmation through double opt-in, and bank account validation for payment processing. THE platform SHALL integrate with third-party verification services to ensure business legitimacy and prevent fraudulent applications.

### Approval Workflow

WHEN a seller submits their complete application, THE system SHALL initiate a structured approval workflow involving automated document verification, manual review by platform administrators, background checks through business intelligence databases, and final approval from qualified platform personnel. THE approval process SHALL complete within 3-5 business days for standard applications, with expedited processing available for verified businesses with existing marketplace presence.

THE system SHALL maintain detailed audit trails throughout the approval process, documenting every review action, communication with applicants, verification results, and final approval decisions. WHERE applications require additional information, THE platform SHALL provide clear communication channels and standardized request templates to ensure consistent applicant experience.

### Seller Onboarding Requirements

UPON successful application approval, THE system SHALL guide new sellers through a comprehensive onboarding process including platform terms acceptance, commission structure acknowledgment, shipping policy agreement, return policy compliance, and quality standards commitment. THE onboarding SHALL include mandatory training modules covering platform policies, product listing guidelines, order fulfillment requirements, customer service standards, and account management procedures.

THE seller dashboard SHALL provide personalized onboarding checklists, step-by-step setup wizards, video tutorials for common tasks, documentation libraries with policy guides, and direct access to seller support representatives. THE system SHALL track onboarding progress and provide completion certificates before sellers can list their first products.

## Product Management

### Catalog Management

THE product management system SHALL enable sellers to create, edit, and manage their product catalogs through an intuitive interface supporting bulk operations, variant creation, media uploads, and rich content management. WHEN sellers create new products, THE system SHALL provide templates for different product types, automated category suggestions, attribute recommendation engines, and SEO optimization tools.

THE platform SHALL support advanced product configuration including configurable products with multiple options, grouped products for sets and bundles, downloadable products with license management, subscription-based products with recurring billing, and pre-order functionality with availability management. THE system SHALL maintain inventory synchronization across all product variations and prevent overselling through real-time stock tracking.

### Inventory Management

THE inventory management system SHALL support multi-location inventory tracking, automated low-stock notifications, bulk inventory updates through CSV imports, inventory reservation during checkout processes, and automatic stock adjustments based on order status changes. WHEN inventory levels change, THE system SHALL update product availability across all channels instantly to prevent customer disappointment.

THE platform SHALL provide inventory forecasting tools using historical sales data, seasonal trend analysis, supplier lead time calculations, and demand prediction algorithms to help sellers optimize stock levels. THE system SHALL integrate with popular inventory management systems and support API connections for automated inventory synchronization.

### Pricing and Promotion Tools

THE pricing management system SHALL support dynamic pricing rules, competitive price monitoring, automated markup calculations, promotional pricing with time-based triggers, and volume-based pricing tiers. WHEN sellers set prices, THE system SHALL provide market analysis data, suggested price ranges, competitor pricing insights, and profit margin calculations to support informed pricing decisions.

THE promotion management tools SHALL enable sellers to create discount codes, configure percentage or fixed amount discounts, set minimum purchase requirements, define usage limitations, and schedule promotional campaigns. THE system SHALL support cross-selling recommendations, upselling suggestions, and bundle discount configurations to increase average order values.

## Order Management

### Order Processing Workflow

THE order management system SHALL provide comprehensive order tracking from receipt through fulfillment, automated order acknowledgment to customers, inventory reservation upon order placement, and real-time status updates throughout the fulfillment process. WHEN new orders are received, THE system SHALL notify sellers immediately through dashboard alerts, email notifications, and mobile push notifications based on seller preferences.

THE platform SHALL support partial order fulfillment for multi-item orders, split shipments for products from different warehouses, backorder management for out-of-stock items, and automated order routing to optimal fulfillment locations based on inventory availability and shipping costs. THE system SHALL maintain detailed order histories and provide comprehensive audit trails for all order modifications.

### Customer Communication

THE customer communication system SHALL provide automated order status notifications, shipping confirmation messages with tracking information, delivery updates with estimated arrival times, and proactive communication for delays or issues. WHEN sellers process orders, THE system SHALL generate branded email templates with order details, shipping information, and personalized thank-you messages.

THE platform SHALL support integrated messaging systems enabling direct seller-customer communication for order clarifications, shipping coordination, return authorizations, and general customer service. THE communication system SHALL maintain message histories, support file attachments for receipts or documentation, and provide translation services for international customers.

### Returns and Refunds

THE returns management system SHALL provide automated return authorization based on seller policies, return shipping label generation, inventory updates upon return receipt, and refund processing integration with payment systems. WHEN customers request returns, THE system SHALL verify return eligibility based on product type, purchase date, seller policies, and original order conditions.

THE platform SHALL support partial returns for multi-item orders, exchange processing for size or color changes, condition assessment workflows for returned items, and restocking fee calculations based on seller policies. THE system SHALL provide comprehensive return analytics including return reasons, product performance metrics, and seller-specific return rates to identify improvement opportunities.

## Performance Analytics

### Sales Performance Metrics

THE analytics system SHALL provide real-time sales performance dashboards showing order volumes, revenue trends, profit margins, conversion rates, and customer acquisition metrics. WHEN sellers access analytics, THE system SHALL display customizable time periods, comparative period analysis, product performance rankings, and geographic sales distribution.

THE platform SHALL offer predictive analytics including demand forecasting, seasonal trend analysis, customer lifetime value predictions, and inventory optimization recommendations. THE system SHALL provide automated reporting with scheduled email delivery, custom report builders, and data export capabilities for external analysis tools.

### Customer Behavior Analysis

THE customer analytics system SHALL track and analyze customer browsing patterns, purchase histories, cart abandonment rates, repeat purchase behaviors, and customer satisfaction scores. WHEN sellers review customer data, THE system SHALL provide demographic insights, purchasing preference analysis, customer journey mapping, and retention rate calculations.

THE analytics SHALL include segmentation tools enabling sellers to categorize customers by purchase frequency, average order value, product preferences, geographic location, and customer lifetime value. THE system SHALL provide actionable insights for targeted marketing campaigns, personalized product recommendations, and customer retention strategies.

### Competitive Intelligence

THE competitive analysis system SHALL monitor competitor pricing, product assortment comparisons, market share analysis, and customer review sentiment comparison. WHEN sellers access competitive intelligence, THE system SHALL provide pricing alerts for key products, feature comparison matrices, and competitive positioning analysis.

THE platform SHALL track market trends including category growth rates, emerging product opportunities, seasonal demand patterns, and customer preference shifts. THE system SHALL provide market opportunity alerts, trending product suggestions, and strategic recommendations for product portfolio expansion.

## Commission Structure

### Revenue Sharing Model

THE commission system SHALL operate on a tiered revenue-sharing model where platform commission rates decrease as seller sales volume increases. THE basic commission structure SHALL start at 15% for sellers with monthly sales under $10,000, decrease to 12% for sales between $10,001-$50,000, reduce to 10% for sales between $50,001-$100,000, and apply 8% commission for sales exceeding $100,000 monthly.

THE platform SHALL calculate commissions based on product category with different rates for electronics (12% base), fashion (18% base), home goods (15% base), beauty products (20% base), and specialty items (custom rates). WHERE promotional discounts are applied, THE commission SHALL be calculated on the final sale price after customer discounts while maintaining seller profitability thresholds.

### Fee Structure

THE platform SHALL charge additional fees including payment processing fees (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction), shipping label fees for platform-generated labels, listing fees for premium product placements, and subscription fees for advanced seller tools. THE fee system SHALL provide transparent pricing calculators showing total cost breakdowns before sellers list products or accept orders.

THE commission system SHALL handle promotional campaigns allowing sellers to opt into platform-wide sales events, category-specific promotions, and targeted marketing campaigns with negotiated commission adjustments. WHEN sellers participate in promotional events, THE system SHALL provide sales volume predictions, cost-benefit analysis, and performance tracking for promotional effectiveness.

### Payout Calculations

THE payout system SHALL automatically calculate net earnings by deducting commissions, fees, refunds, and chargebacks from gross sales while maintaining detailed transaction records for accounting purposes. THE system SHALL provide real-time earnings dashboards, daily transaction summaries, and monthly financial statements with tax documentation preparation.

THE platform SHALL support multiple payout currencies with automatic currency conversion at competitive exchange rates, international tax withholding compliance, and regulatory reporting for cross-border transactions. THE system SHALL maintain separate reserve accounts for potential refunds or disputes while providing clear reserve release schedules to sellers.

## Payment Processing

### Payout Schedules

THE payment system SHALL process seller payouts on a bi-weekly schedule for established sellers with 14-day clearing periods and weekly payouts for premium sellers with proven track records. THE payout schedule SHALL be customizable for enterprise sellers with negotiated terms including daily payouts for high-volume sellers with excellent performance metrics.

THE platform SHALL provide payout scheduling flexibility allowing sellers to request early payouts for a fee, schedule custom payout dates, set minimum payout thresholds, and choose between multiple payout methods including bank transfers, PayPal, and paper checks. THE system SHALL send payout notifications with detailed earnings breakdowns and transaction histories.

### Payment Methods

THE payment processing system SHALL support multiple payout methods including ACH bank transfers (1-3 business days), PayPal transfers (instant for verified accounts), wire transfers for international sellers (1-5 business days), and paper checks by mail (5-10 business days). THE system SHALL automatically select the most cost-effective payment method based on seller location and payout amount.

THE platform SHALL maintain detailed payment history including transaction dates, payout amounts, payment methods, processing fees, and transaction references. THE system SHALL provide payment reconciliation tools, failed payment reprocessing, and payment dispute resolution through integrated customer service channels.

### Account Management

THE seller financial dashboard SHALL provide comprehensive account management including earnings tracking with historical comparisons, expense categorization for tax purposes, invoice generation for business customers, and tax document preparation including 1099 forms for US-based sellers. THE system SHALL integrate with popular accounting software including QuickBooks, Xero, and FreshBooks for automated financial record keeping.

THE platform SHALL offer financial planning tools including sales forecasting for budgeting, expense tracking with budget alerts, tax estimation calculators, and profit margin analysis across product categories. THE system SHALL provide cash flow projections, seasonal trend analysis, and financial performance benchmarking against similar sellers.

## Quality Control

### Performance Monitoring

THE quality control system SHALL monitor seller performance through automated metrics tracking including order fulfillment times, customer satisfaction scores, return rates, product quality complaints, and shipping performance. WHEN performance metrics fall below platform standards, THE system SHALL generate automatic alerts and initiate performance improvement plans.

THE platform SHALL establish minimum performance standards including order acknowledgment within 24 hours, shipment within 2 business days, customer response within 48 hours, product rating maintenance above 4.0 stars, and return rates below 10%. THE system SHALL provide performance improvement resources including training modules, mentoring programs, and operational consulting for underperforming sellers.

### Compliance Monitoring

THE compliance monitoring system SHALL continuously review seller activities for policy violations including product authenticity verification, prohibited item detection, pricing policy compliance, and customer service standard adherence. WHEN compliance issues are detected, THE system SHALL generate automated warnings, impose temporary restrictions, and escalate serious violations for platform administrator review.

THE platform SHALL maintain comprehensive audit trails for all seller activities, product listings, order processing, customer communications, and policy enforcement actions. THE compliance system SHALL provide regular compliance reports, policy update notifications, and training resources to ensure ongoing seller education and platform integrity.

### Seller Rating System

THE seller rating system SHALL aggregate customer feedback into comprehensive performance scores based on product quality (40% weight), shipping performance (25% weight), customer service (25% weight), and overall satisfaction (10% weight). THE rating calculation SHALL use weighted averages over the past 12 months with recent performance given higher impact on overall scores.

THE platform SHALL provide detailed rating breakdowns showing performance trends, comparative analysis against category averages, specific improvement recommendations, and recognition programs for high-performing sellers. THE rating system SHALL influence search result placement, promotional opportunities, and platform fee structures to reward excellent seller performance.

## Seller Support

### Customer Service

THE seller support system SHALL provide multi-channel customer service including live chat support during business hours, email support with 24-hour response guarantees, phone support for premium sellers, and comprehensive help desk ticket management. WHEN sellers request support, THE system SHALL provide intelligent routing to specialized support agents based on inquiry type and seller tier.

THE support system SHALL maintain comprehensive knowledge bases with searchable FAQ sections, video tutorial libraries, step-by-step guides, policy documentation, and best practice recommendations. THE platform SHALL provide proactive support through regular communication updates, policy change notifications, performance improvement suggestions, and training opportunity announcements.

### Training and Development

THE seller education system SHALL provide mandatory training for new sellers covering platform policies, product listing optimization, order management procedures, customer service standards, and performance expectations. THE training platform SHALL include interactive modules, certification programs, advanced specialization courses, and continuing education requirements for ongoing platform participation.

THE platform SHALL offer advanced training programs including category-specific selling strategies, seasonal preparation workshops, international expansion guidance, and business growth consulting for established sellers. THE training system SHALL track completion rates, assess learning outcomes, provide certification credentials, and offer personalized learning paths based on seller performance and growth objectives.

### Technical Support

THE technical support system SHALL provide comprehensive assistance for platform usage, API integration support, technical troubleshooting, system status notifications, and feature request management. WHEN sellers experience technical issues, THE support system SHALL provide immediate acknowledgment, estimated resolution times, status updates throughout the resolution process, and post-resolution follow-up to ensure satisfaction.

THE platform SHALL maintain developer resources including comprehensive API documentation, code examples and libraries, sandbox environments for testing, and developer community forums for peer support. THE technical support SHALL include software integration assistance, data migration services, custom development consulting, and priority support for enterprise sellers with complex technical requirements.

## Success Metrics and KPIs

### Seller Acquisition Metrics

THE platform SHALL track seller acquisition through monthly active seller counts, new seller registration rates, seller application approval percentages, time-to-first-sale metrics, and seller retention rates across different time periods. THE acquisition analytics SHALL identify successful recruitment channels, optimal seller profiles, geographical expansion opportunities, and seasonal registration patterns.

THE seller success metrics SHALL measure average time to profitability for new sellers, platform revenue per active seller, seller satisfaction scores through regular surveys, seller-to-customer conversion rates, and average seller lifetime value. THE platform SHALL benchmark performance against industry standards and competitive platforms to identify improvement opportunities and best practices for seller success optimization.
